note: Rejudged after rfc5176_coa_values_test.go updated its vsa() helper from raw[2:] to raw (matching radius.EncodeVSA now returning the Vendor-Specific attribute value directly as the inverse of DecodeVSA, producing byte-identical wire packets) and after 585fcdb081 admitted canonical Birth identity in oneSessionService(t). Re-read RFC 5176 Section 2.3 Attributes ('In CoA-Request and Disconnect-Request packets, all attributes MUST be treated as mandatory. If one or more authorization changes specified in a CoA-Request cannot be carried out, the NAS MUST send a CoA-NAK. A NAS MUST respond to a CoA-Request containing one or more unsupported attributes or Attribute values with a CoA-NAK ... A NAS MUST respond to a Disconnect-Request containing one or more unsupported attributes or Attribute values with a Disconnect-NAK'). All eight tagged units retain exact NAK 401/407, zero event emission, zero teardown and positive ACK assertions for unsupported attribute types, unsupported values beside supported ones (including unknown-vendor VSA and Disconnect MikroTik VSA via vsa()), and the eleven unimplemented identification attributes.
